provenance: Caller-agent review synthetic corpus with explicit annotated spans. Not independent human review, not customer data and not a retroactive hold-out split.
scope_notes: Six simple edge cases: one positive and one negative per entity.
Gold spans are explicit annotations, not outputs of the production regexes.
The EMAIL positive deliberately places a final period after the address; surrounding punctuation is outside the annotated span.

cases.label: email_final_period_positive
cases.notes: Caller review found that a terminal period prevented an otherwise valid address from being masked. Gold excludes the final period.

cases.label: email_no_tld_negative
cases.notes: No dotted domain or TLD; not an email under the documented format boundary.

cases.label: phone_too_short_negative
cases.notes: One digit too short for the documented mobile shape.

cases.label: mykad_too_short_negative
cases.notes: One digit too short for the documented 12-digit MyKad shape.
